selection_scope: One fixed weighted 3-by-3 exact-combo range fixture, one 10-chip stack and two predeclared half-delay checkpoints. Preflight both grouped-world admission cases before any training. Independently assert the eight compatible private-pair keys, single overlap, flop blocker, physical-world counts and posterior probabilities from hand-counted rational weights. Independently replay every completed policy over original physical worlds and exact legal visible-information best responses. Retain all preflight rejections and target misses; do not simplify or retry. Preserve the unchanged NashConv + 1e-10 <= 0.005 target. One descriptive complete-call-plus-JSON measurement per completed case; no memory or speedup comparison.
model_limits: Finite conditioned heads-up preflop/flop game with three weighted exact combos per player, two selected flops, 4,704 ordered future candidates and 27,720 compatible physical worlds, and forced checkdown after flop betting. One shared 10-chip stack, two requested iteration ceilings, configured preflop raises/all-ins and rich flop actions. Not broad-range/full-deck, all-streets, multiway, unrestricted NLHE, or a general convergence claim.
